source_findings.finding: The real accept operation returns accept_result without publishing the accepted progress state; session_operation specializes reconcile only. Complete reconciliation in s1_recovery.py:512 builds an ordinary summary without populating publisher rows or acceptance.
source_findings.required: Publish independently retained complete/first/runtime authority through the real accepted path before final sample; retain failed outcome on any later sample failure.

source_findings.finding: Publication recovers verified_progress_reference, then an ordinary evidence_summary_record unconditionally replaces that summary. s1_progress.recover returns raw first/runtime records whereas terminal_receipt currently consumes status/value envelopes.
source_findings.required: Define a single exact merge and summary adapter; ordinary compatibility metadata cannot erase acknowledged progress, unknown states or verified first/runtime references.

source_findings.finding: reconcile_rows has no acknowledged-worker input and seals unique fallback variants as reconcile authority. validate_checkpoint only validates the shape of a claimed worker_reference; Consumer compares versions without resolving that reference against accepted worker rows/seals.
source_findings.required: Bind reusable worker authority to exact acknowledged worker checkpoint/seal. Record conflicting unsealed candidates without erasing established authority; conflicts block complete acceptance, and absent worker authority excludes all variants.

source_findings.finding: Several nested fields use equality without exact primitive typing or closed enums: work_deadline can compare equal across bool/int; notice request_id/binding comparisons lack typed validation; runtime keys are arbitrary; cold reference fields have no complete primitive validator. recover never checks the cold head schema value and accepts some damaged head forms as optional.
source_findings.required: Finish exact typed context/checkpoint/head/notice/ack/reference validators and collect the full tamper, optional-newest, credential and deadline matrix. Preserve the distinction between accepted-metadata corruption and optional newest damage.

source_findings.finding: candidate_inventory hashes result.json but uses caller-provided result rows without proving they match those bytes; final inventory readback covers only row-file sources and does not re-establish discovered directory membership. This leaves source/snapshot binding incomplete.
source_findings.required: Choose and bind a bounded closed inventory snapshot, verify supplied result matches it, and invalidate coverage on observed mutation; do not certify unsealed partial inventory as a lower bound.

source_findings.finding: There is no fresh original-W check between mailbox installation returning and worker Popen. In stages.segment, native work is followed by serialization before publish_segment_row observes the clock.
source_findings.required: Place original-clock checks after slow setup/native work and before new launch/serialization; collect before/equal/after-W behavior without resetting the original deadline.

source_findings.finding: P01-P06 are declared, but all saved final-run instances stop at the CPU assertion. Existing pure metadata/inventory/primitive methods cover only 40 callbacks; queue/credential/authority/full publication faults and exact six loss boundaries remain unsupported.
source_findings.required: Reach all six real boundaries using current production integration and retained owners, then require the complete current-source aggregate without removing old assertions/scenarios.

source_findings.finding: record_census adds every readable ancestor and counts every thread. On the escalated host this includes the pre-existing Codex, shell, terminal and system processes.
source_findings.required: A new plan must explicitly bind owned-workload accounting and retain raw full ancestry separately; historical Plan045 failures remain false and unchanged.
